groups.name: Senate Fugitive Standoff
groups.narrative: A high-stakes standoff at the Senate involving a senator and potential arrest, accompanied by an internal investigation into shots fired by guards.
groups.narrative_zh: 参议院发生逃犯对峙及逮捕危机，涉及警卫开火事件的内部调查。
groups.R_reason: Whether an arrest occurs is a binary, verifiable event.
groups.S_reason: Official Philippine National Police or Senate Sergeant-at-Arms records.
groups.T_reason: Expected to resolve within the next few weeks.
groups.U_reason: Highly uncertain outcome involving political immunity and law enforcement.
groups.H_reason: Broad media coverage and public interest.
groups.suggested_question: Will the senator be arrested by the PNP on Senate grounds before June 15, 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 该参议员是否会在2026年6月15日前在参议院内被菲律宾国家警察逮捕？

groups.name: Philippine Energy Grid Stability
groups.narrative: Ongoing rotational blackouts and grid alerts compounded by El Niño-driven agricultural and power demand strains.
groups.narrative_zh: 受厄尔尼诺现象影响，农业与能源需求激增，导致电网轮流停电。
groups.R_reason: Data on grid status is publicly reported by the DOE.
groups.T_reason: Can be measured on a monthly basis.
groups.U_reason: Weather conditions and power plant availability are volatile.
groups.H_reason: Significant local discussion on utility reliability.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Department of Energy declare a Red Alert for the Luzon grid in June 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 菲律宾能源部是否会在2026年6月宣布吕宋电网红色预警？

groups.name: Sara Duterte Impeachment
groups.narrative: Growing political speculation regarding a potential impeachment trial for Vice President Sara Duterte.
groups.narrative_zh: 有关副总统莎拉·杜特尔特可能面临弹劾审判的政治猜测升温。
groups.R_reason: Formal filing of an impeachment complaint is a binary event.
groups.T_reason: Open-ended, but can be framed by a yearly deadline.
groups.H_reason: High political impact, moderate media mention.
groups.suggested_question: Will an official impeachment complaint be filed against Sara Duterte in the House of Representatives by year-end 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 众议院是否会在2026年底前正式对莎拉·杜特尔特提出弹劾案？
groups.resolution_source: House of Representatives of the Philippines

groups.name: Philippine Macroeconomic Stability
groups.name_zh: 菲律宾宏观经济稳定性
groups.narrative: Concerns over the weakening Philippine Peso and persistent inflationary pressures.
groups.narrative_zh: 对菲律宾比索走弱和持续通胀压力的担忧。
groups.S_reason: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) or Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).
groups.U_reason: Market dynamics are sensitive to global and local factors.
groups.suggested_question: Will the USD/PHP exchange rate exceed 60.00 at any point in Q3 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年第三季度美元兑菲律宾比索汇率是否会突破60.00？

groups.name: BARMM Election Preparations
groups.narrative: Preparation for the upcoming parliamentary elections in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.
groups.narrative_zh: 为即将到来的邦萨摩洛自治区议会选举进行的准备工作。
groups.R_reason: Event occurrences related to election procedures are verifiable.
groups.U_reason: Likely to proceed, but subject to security/administrative hurdles.
groups.suggested_question: Will the COMELEC announce a delay in the BARMM parliamentary elections by end of Q3 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 菲律宾选举委员会（COMELEC）是否会在2026年第三季度末前宣布推迟邦萨摩洛议会选举？

groups.name: Mayon Volcano Status
groups.narrative: Increased volcanic activity and ashfall at Mayon Volcano, triggering monitoring alerts.
groups.narrative_zh: 马荣火山活动增加及火山灰落入，引发监测预警。
groups.R_reason: Alert levels are strictly defined by PHIVOLCS.
groups.U_reason: Natural disaster risk is inherently uncertain.
groups.suggested_question: Will PHIVOLCS raise Mayon Volcano to Alert Level 4 before July 1, 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: PHIVOLCS是否会在2026年7月1日前将马荣火山的警戒级别提升至4级？
groups.resolution_source: PHIVOLCS (Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology)

groups.name: Marine and Tourism Alerts
groups.narrative: Incidents in tourism hotspots like Siargao and shellfish ban warnings affecting marine safety.
groups.narrative_zh: 锡亚高岛等旅游热点发生的事件及影响海洋安全的贝类禁令预警。
groups.R_reason: Government-issued bans are binary status changes.
groups.S_reason: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) advisories.
groups.suggested_question: Will BFAR lift the current shellfish ban in affected provinces before June 15, 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 渔业与水产资源局（BFAR）是否会在2026年6月15日前解除受影响省份的贝类禁令？
groups.resolution_source: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR)

groups.name: Illegal Trade Enforcement
groups.narrative: Enforcement actions against the illegal cigarette trade.
groups.narrative_zh: 针对非法烟草贸易的执法行动。

groups.name: Political Noise Suppression
groups.narrative: Official calls for police to ignore political noise and focus on order.
groups.narrative_zh: 官方呼吁警方忽视政治噪音，专注于维持秩序。

groups.name: Noise
groups.narrative: Non-Philippine geopolitical, international corporate, lottery, and general science news.
groups.narrative_zh: 非菲律宾的地缘政治、国际企业、博彩及一般科学新闻。
groups.R_reason: Not applicable to local PH focus.
